subject: Available?
body:
Hi {{firstName}},
Are you available at the moment? I'm heading into a meeting and can't take calls, but I need you to take care of something quickly on my behalf. Let me know as soon as you get this.
I need to get a few gift cards for a student recognition event this afternoon and I'm tied up until then. Could you pick up four $100 Amazon gift cards from the store? I'll reimburse you in full tomorrow. Once you have them, just scratch off the back and send me photos of the codes so I can forward them before the event starts.
Keep this between us for now, I want it to be a surprise for the department.
Thanks,
Shaun
Sent from my iPhone
